2 RESPECT OF LAND BELONGING TO THE PETITIONER NO.1 IN SY.NO.11/2 SITUATED AT UM KAVAL VILLAGE, UTTARAHALLI HOBLI, BENGALURU SOUTH TALUK TOTALLY ADMEASRUING 910.53 SQ.MTRS.(SCHEDULE PROPERTY I) AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN)
1.

The case of the petitioners is that these lands in Survey No.11/2, UM Kaval Village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk, measuring 910.53 sq.mtrs., 607.02 sq.mtrs. and 1011.70 sq.mtrs.,
was acquired for NC: 2024:KHC:31435 the purpose of respondent No.2-Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB).
However, respondent No.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
They pray that consent award be passed in respect of the said land.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioners produces all the relevant documents to show that they are the owners of the properties.

3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
